citations.narrative:
An enclosure housing three adult degus was in need of cleaning. The wooden platforms in the enclosure have extensive
urine staining. The boards which were construction lumber had turned a deep mottled brown with white areas.
Accumulations of excreta can lead to contamination of the animals, may lead to disease, and create odors. Excreta shall
be removed from primary enclosures as often as necessary to prevent contamination of the animals contained therein and
to minimize disease hazards and to reduce odors. Correct by ensuring that excreta is removed as often as necessary to
prevent accumulation that may affect the animals
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
